name: Unrecoverable task-critical control disappearance
summary: A required action or route becomes hidden in narrow composition with no equivalent access, preventing the intended workflow.
recurring_structure: Responsive hiding/removal of the only control or navigation path needed to finish the same task; no disclosure or alternative route available.
harm_mechanism: Users cannot reach required functionality when width changes; in the conditions covered by WCAG SC 1.4.10 this could represent loss of functionality. Primer instructs preservation of full function across smaller screens.
context: Same task must remain operable in constrained and wide viewports.
applicability: The removed control is demonstrably required for the user's active workflow and no equivalent path remains.
legitimate_contexts: Action not applicable on a mobile-specific workflow.
Redundant copy removed while an equivalent accessible action remains.
Decorative or optional content removed with no functional consequence.

usability: Missing required task route/action can block completion; no independent task experiment executed.
accessibility: Potential SC 1.4.10 loss-of-functionality issue under relevant test context; no actual WCAG audit performed.
performance: No negative or positive performance effect measured.
maintainability: Unspecified; no direct technical debt observation.

counterexamples.summary: A sidebar may disappear visually if a discoverable equivalent view preserves every required operation.
counterexamples.context: Mobile task navigation via an accessible alternate view.

version_context: WCAG 2.2 2024; Primer docs unpinned; pinned PageLayout implementation 7f5303d803986887187d86dcebaeda22a4dc6823
